The script does not explicitly request any compute resources (e.g., '--ntasks=1', '--cpus-per-task=1'). While the job may run with system defaults, it is best practice to explicitly request resources to ensure predictable behavior. Given the queue name 'normal_serial', a request of '--ntasks=1' is strongly recommended.

The script is designed for job array submission and relies on the `FLUX_JOB_ARRAY_TASK_ID` variable. If a user mistakenly submits this script as a single job (e.g., with `flux submit`), the variable will be unset. This will cause the `PT` variable to be calculated as 0, which may lead to incorrect behavior or repeated processing of the same data.
Sourcing `~/.bashrc` is not recommended in non-interactive batch scripts as it can introduce unexpected behavior, dependencies, or errors from commands intended only for interactive sessions.
